The preliminary full-wrench bolt-group screen gives approximately:

1.129 kN maximum axial increment per position.
0.690 kN shear increment per position.

Eight 25 mm-OD socket approaches clear the represented bare frame only after adding real 30 mm-ID access tunnels. The steel liners add about 5.97 kg.

That solves bolt access, but it does not complete the exchange. Four 1 mm contact tiles create a 1 mm installed stand-off; a further controlled 0.2 mm opening provides 1.2 mm extraction space. The executed tile, tab and gripper sweeps still collide on two of four withdrawal paths.

Thus accessible bolts do not establish a removable joint.

Moment-carrying strut end

The second candidate is a 60 mm-across-flats prismatic tongue with three bearing rails, two radial-bearing stations 80 mm apart, positive torsional keys and axial pins. It carries moments through separated contacts; it is not a pivoting clevis.

With six nominal 5 kN radial preloads, the preliminary contact screen gives:

Maximum radial increment: 2.417 kN.
Remaining compression: at least 2.583 kN.
Nominal peak bearing pressure: approximately 12.36 MPa.
Torque transfer at 250 Nm: 2.778 kN per rail at 30 mm radius.
